purpose: Minimum data contract for rendering portfolio monitoring state in the dashboard.

dashboardSections.title: Open Research Tasks
dashboardSections.description: Actionable pipeline grouped by priority and company.

dashboardSections.title: Thesis Review Queue
dashboardSections.description: Companies/tasks requiring thesis review after material events.

dashboardSections.title: Upcoming Events
dashboardSections.description: Known future events relevant to monitored companies.

dashboardSections.title: Recent Research Outputs
dashboardSections.description: Latest preliminary reports, Deep Dives, mini-memos or task outputs.

dashboardSections.title: Company State Detail
dashboardSections.description: Per-company thesis state, drivers, risks, watch metrics, open questions, recent events and research outputs.
